name: Nord
source:
Nord is the first love interest you meet in Lovewood. He is the cheerful messenger to the royal court, serving as a general legman for Lord Oberon and helping out with chores around town.

He also makes an appearance as one of the two main characters in When Trees Turn to Ice.
